headword: {色素|しきそ}{沈着|ちんちゃく}

definitions.explanation: The deposit of pigment in the skin, resulting in darker patches or spots. A common dermatological concern caused by sun exposure, inflammation, aging, or hormonal changes.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日焼|ひや}け→日焼け：15469_hiyake⟧⟦による→による：28349_niyoru⟧{色素|しきそ}{沈着|ちんちゃく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{注意|ちゅうい}→注意：01464_chuui⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please be careful about pigmentation from sunburn.

examples.japanese: ⟦ニキビ→ニキビ：22122_nikibi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{跡|あと}→跡：02174_ato⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{色素|しきそ}{沈着|ちんちゃく}になってしまった。
examples.english: The acne scars turned into pigmentation marks.

examples.japanese: {色素|しきそ}{沈着|ちんちゃく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{防|ふせ}ぐ→防ぐ：02409_fusegu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{紫外線|しがいせん}→紫外線：07375_shigaisen⟧⟦{対策|たいさく}→対策：02511_taisaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧だ。
examples.english: To prevent pigmentation, UV protection is important.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{色素|しきそ}→色素：19991_shikiso⟧ (pigment; coloring matter) + ⟦{沈着|ちんちゃく}→沈着：09171_chinchaku⟧ (deposition; settling). A medical and skincare term that is widely understood due to the popularity of skincare culture in Japan.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {色素|しきそ}{沈着|ちんちゃく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{防|ふせ}ぐ→防ぐ：02409_fusegu⟧: to prevent pigmentation
- {色素|しきそ}{沈着|ちんちゃく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{起|お}きる→起きる：00521_okiru⟧: pigmentation occurs
- {色素|しきそ}{沈着|ちんちゃく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{改善|かいぜん}する→改善する：26828_kaizensuru⟧: to improve pigmentation
- {炎症後|えんしょうご}{色素|しきそ}{沈着|ちんちゃく}: post-inflammatory hyperpigmentation

COMMON CAUSES:
- ⟦{紫外線|しがいせん}→紫外線：07375_shigaisen⟧: UV rays
- ⟦ニキビ→ニキビ：22122_nikibi⟧や⟦けが→けが：00787_kega⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{跡|あと}→跡：02174_ato⟧: acne or injury scars
- ⟦{加齢|かれい}→加齢：11821_karei⟧: aging
- ⟦ホルモン→ホルモン：29936_horumon⟧⟦{変化|へんか}→変化：03615_henka⟧: hormonal changes

SIMILAR WORDS:
- シミ: age spots; dark spots — the everyday word for visible pigmentation spots on the skin
- ⟦{黒|くろ}→黒：02205_kuro⟧ずみ: darkening; dark patches — more casual, used for skin darkening in general
- ⟦{日焼|ひや}け→日焼け：15469_hiyake⟧⟦{跡|あと}→跡：02174_ato⟧: sunburn marks — specifically from sun exposure
